amendments.by: Manager (recovery from infeasible first run; User-approved 'fix & re-run')
changes: Performance: log-rank vectorised O(n^2)->O(n log n) (sort + searchsorted). EQUIVALENCE-PRESERVING: identical statistic, verified vs the reference loop to max|diff|=2.22e-15 over 200 random cases incl. ties. Not a methodology change. The first run stalled because the O(n^2) loop x ~200k calls at n~5000 single-threaded projected to ~10h.

Parameter: B_baseline_pairs 200 -> 50. Rationale: exact W2 on ~5000-point diagrams is ~22s/pair; 200 pairs x 2 dims would be ~37 min and contend with the active T1.5 4-worker run. At B_baseline=50 the observed H0 cross-distance (W2~136.7) dwarfs the null-null pairs, so rejection is unambiguous; toy budget preserved.

Solver clarification: baseline W2 uses gudhi.hera.wasserstein_distance (exact, bundled C++, no POT dependency). POT (`ot`) is absent in the worktree .venv, so trajectory_tda.topology.vectorisation.wasserstein_distance would silently fall back to greedy matching; gudhi.hera is used directly to guarantee an EXACT W2 baseline. n_jobs reduced 4->2 to coexist with T1.5.

entries.name: STRAND vs W2/landscape testing comparison (toy scale)
entries.objective: Decide whether STRAND (Kaplan-Meier persistence-survival + log-rank) adds calibrated two-sample testing power or localisation beyond the P01-B Wasserstein-2 + persistence-landscape-L2 permutation pipeline, or reduces to a persistence-lifetime reparameterisation, on a toy-scale comparison over FROZEN P01-B diagrams. No paper-facing claim is licensed; this task decides PROMOTE-to-full-scale / PARK / KILL only.
entries.contrast: BHPS observed vs USoc observed persistence diagrams (the P01-B headline cross-dataset contrast), H0 and H1 separately, using the frozen-loadings cached diagrams. All three methods test the SAME two-sample BHPS-vs-USoc contrast.

strand_construction.persistence_value: p = d - b per finite feature; the single infinite H0 essential class excluded
strand_construction.representation: per-group Kaplan-Meier survival S(t) = P(p > t), each lifetime a fully-observed event time
strand_construction.statistic: log-rank two-sample statistic between the BHPS and USoc lifetime groups (vectorised O(n log n) implementation; statistic unchanged)
strand_construction.vectorisation: g = 25 grid; STRAND and STRAND-F (STRAND-F appends the birth-time survival curve)

baselines: Wasserstein-2 two-sample test of BHPS-obs vs USoc-obs diagrams: observed statistic = W2(bhps_obs, usoc_obs) via gudhi.hera (exact, order=2, internal_p=2); null = W2 between independent BHPS-null and USoc-null diagram pairs (CROSS null-null), B_baseline=50 pairs subsampled (seed=42) from the 1000x1000 cached nulls; one-sided p=(r+1)/(B+1) (observed >= null = more different).
persistence-landscape L2 two-sample test, identical CROSS null-null construction (k_max=5, n_points=200), B_baseline=50. Reuses trajectory_tda._battery_core landscape helpers.

null_model.strand: pool all finite lifetimes from both groups, relabel into two groups of the original sizes, recompute per-group Kaplan-Meier + log-rank; B=1000, two-sided, p=(r+1)/(B+1)
null_model.invariance_requirement: the permuted grouping must change the per-group KM curves and the log-rank statistic; assert non-invariance (null-operation-invariance-audit) before trusting any p-value
null_model.baselines: cross null-null permutation: observed cross-dataset distance vs the distribution of BHPS-null-vs-USoc-null distances (B_baseline=50)

calibration.construction: Type-I error of STRAND under its own null on matched groups (two samples drawn from the SAME dataset's pooled lifetimes); n_calibration_trials=100; for each trial compute the STRAND log-rank permutation p-value (B=1000); KS of the trial p-values vs Uniform(0,1)

key_params.null_model: label-permutation (pool, relabel to original group sizes, recompute KM + log-rank)
key_params.baseline_null: cross null-null (BHPS-null vs USoc-null diagram pairs), subsampled seed=42 from the cached 1000x1000
key_params.representation: FROZEN P01-B PCA loadings + maxmin landmarks; transform-only; no refit

decision_rule.miscalibrated: NOT calibrated (ks_p < 0.05) OR STRAND not faithfully implementable from arXiv:2606.11911 OR the label-permutation null is invariant to STRAND's input -> Outcome C: KILL / [NEGATIVE]; keep W2/landscape; feed lesson to Scout. No power claim is interpretable under miscalibration.
decision_rule.additive: calibrated (ks_p >= 0.05) AND on >=1 of the H0/H1 contrasts STRAND agrees in direction with W2/landscape where they reject AND adds lifetime-range localisation the omnibus cannot provide, OR detects a calibrated difference at comparable-or-greater power at toy scale -> Outcome A: PROMOTE to a full-scale P01-B methods-extension pre-reg (new APM task); candidate -> registered.
decision_rule.redundant: calibrated (ks_p >= 0.05) but conclusions concordant-without-addition (no localisation beyond W2/landscape; reduces to lifetime reparameterisation) -> Outcome B: PARK with revisit trigger (a dataset where the omnibus is ambiguous but lifetime localisation matters); keep W2/landscape primary; candidate -> parked.

outcome_to_prose.additive: No P01-B prose yet. Open a full-scale STRAND methods-extension APM task with its own pre-reg; only that task's result may license manuscript text (e.g. a complementary interpretable testing layer in P01-B methods/SI).
outcome_to_prose.redundant: No P01-B prose change; W2 + landscape-L2 remain the locked primary tests. Optional one-line SI note that a survival reparameterisation added no testing power.
outcome_to_prose.miscalibrated: Write a [NEGATIVE] note; keep W2/landscape; feed 'STRAND not calibrated on our diagrams / await reference implementation' to the Scout watchlist.

entries.execution_guardrails: Toy scale: single observed BHPS-vs-USoc diagram pair per homology dimension from the frozen caches. STRAND main + calibration use the vectorised log-rank (~minutes total). Baseline B_baseline=50 cross null-null W2 pairs via gudhi.hera (~22s/pair, n_jobs=2 to coexist with T1.5; ~9-18 min). Verify both frozen caches exist at PROJ_ROOT before any compute. Do NOT refit the representation. Nothing is written outside results/trajectory_tda_strand/ and the vault. ANTI-FABRICATION: every number in the output JSON must be computed from the real cached diagrams; if any step is not faithfully implementable, report Partial - do NOT synthesize or place-hold p-values.

inputs.baseline_headline_jsons: committed P01-B W2/landscape headline JSONs (T1.2a USoc, T1.2b BHPS) for sanity cross-check
